set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,shlex,subprocess,re
build=pathlib.Path('build/idf-stage28e-c-memory-audit-v1')
cc=json.loads((build/'compile_commands.json').read_text())
targets=['ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp','Stage27TelemetryLogger.cpp','Stage28ServiceConsole.cpp','Stage27TelemetryReporter.cpp','BleClimateScanner.cpp']
for target in targets:
    matches=[e for e in cc if e['file'].endswith('/'+target)]
    if not matches:
        print('STAGE28E_C_STACK_SKIP',target); continue
    e=matches[0]; args=list(e.get('arguments') or shlex.split(e['command']))
    out=f'/tmp/stage28e_{target[:-4]}.o'
    for i,a in enumerate(args):
        if a=='-o' and i+1<len(args): args[i+1]=out
    args.append('-fstack-usage')
    subprocess.run(args,cwd=e['directory'],check=True)
    print('STAGE28E_C_STACK_COMPILED',target)
rows=[]
for p in pathlib.Path('/tmp').glob('stage28e_*.su'):
    for line in p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
        parts=line.rsplit('\t',2)
        if len(parts)!=3: continue
        try: size=int(parts[1])
        except ValueError: continue
        rows.append((size,parts[2],parts[0],p.name))
print('STAGE28E_C_TOP_STACK_FRAMES_BEGIN')
for size,kind,name,p in sorted(rows,reverse=True)[:80]: print(f'{size:6d} {kind:12s} {p} {name}')
print('STAGE28E_C_TOP_STACK_FRAMES_END')
PY
